name: Progressive TSDF Fusion & Mesh Extraction
definition: Renders depth and alpha from training views, fuses them into a TSDF grid at increasing voxel resolutions (levels), prunes empty voxels, subdivides, and extracts a mesh via Marching Cubes.
summary: Progressive TSDF Fusion & Mesh Extraction is a multi-resolution surface reconstruction method that fuses depth maps into a TSDF grid, progressively refining resolution while pruning empty space to reduce memory and computational costs.
